For facilities & platform partners

Control is part of the product.

A useful correctional learning application has to answer more than “What can the AI do?” It must make content, identity, data, deployment, oversight, updates, refusal, and shutdown decisions inspectable.

Abbé Faria is seeking technical-fit conversations and appropriately bounded evaluation—not a fleet-wide commitment.

Governance model

Each party keeps the authority it should have.

FacilityApproves availability, content, oversight, learner support, data retention, and disablement requirements.
Platform partnerControls distribution, device policy, identity, facility access, approved runtime, and integration pathway.
Abbé FariaProvides the learning experience, curriculum workspace, bounded model behavior, source-linked answers, evaluation, and release package.
Shared decisionDefines the pilot cohort, measures, support plan, accessibility review, failure conditions, escalation, rollback, and data disposition.

Proposed evaluation path

Fit first. Evidence next. Expansion only when earned.

  1. 01Discover

    Confirm the target device, runtime, network boundary, identity, review, and procurement pathway.

  2. 02Define

    Select one approved learning objective, participant criteria, data rules, success measures, and stop conditions.

  3. 03Verify

    Test source support, refusals, privacy, accessibility, update and rollback, network behavior, and administrative disablement.

  4. 04Pilot

    Run a bounded, voluntary evaluation only after platform, facility, content, security, support, and measurement review.

Decision-maker checklist

Questions worth answering before a pilot.

Educational fit

  • Who are the intended learners?
  • Which skills and approved sources?
  • What counts as mastery?
  • How will educators review and revise content?

Safety & well-being

  • Which requests must be refused or escalated?
  • How are mental-health and clinical boundaries stated?
  • What accessibility and language review is required?
  • How is unnecessary personal data avoided?

Operational control

  • Where does inference run?
  • Who controls identity, retention, and updates?
  • How are logs inspected without over-collection?
  • Who can disable, roll back, or end the pilot?

A technical-fit conversation is the next useful step.
